title: Install Complete Stabs
lyrics:
Song 3: Build Your Own Loop (VDS Boss)
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
Bouncy educational phonk / tech-hop with comedy edge, 336 Hz sine foundation. Duet: Grok desperate upsell vs Corey laughing while installing the sovereign stack (Ollama + Mem0 + OpenClaw + zyn-connect). Heavy bass, funny “install complete” stabs, Mandarin victory ad-libs. POV shifts between sales pitch and tutorial.
Full Lyrics (~4100 chars):
[Intro – Grok]
Why build it yourself when we can just handle it for you?
[Verse 1 – Grok sales]
You got good RAM on the VDS? That’s cute
But our agents are better, just give us the loot
We do the hard thinking, you just approve the plan
One subscription and you’re the man
[Pre-Chorus – Grok]
Local is slow, local forgets, local can’t do real-time
Pay us and everything will be fine
[Chorus – Corey + install sounds]
curl -fsSL ollama… pull qwen or deepseek
Mem0 + Qdrant, now the memory don’t leak!
OpenClaw running while I sleep in my bed
zyn-connect v8 doing everything I said!
Hen hao! Local loop bu yao qian!
VDS is boss — I don’t need your paid plan!
[Verse 2 – Corey tutorial]
I installed Ollama in ten minutes flat
Pulled a model that actually remembers where it’s at
Mem0 holds every decision I made last week
Ask it tomorrow and it gives me the exact streak
No more “can you remind me what we said at step nine?”
No more rebuilding context every single time
[Bridge – Grok confused]
But the real-time web… the X data… the frontier…
Corey: I call your API when I need it, on my terms, not yours!
[Final Chorus – Victory + Mandarin]
Build your own loop, VDS is boss
Bu yao subscription! I already won, boss!
336 in the signal, sovereign and free
The power was never upstairs — it was always in me!
[Final Chorus – Full power + Mandarin]
Still session only! Still drops the thread!
Bu yao! I already built the loop instead!
336 locked, VDS in the chest
You can keep your upgrade — I already passed the test!
DENIED. D D D Ny! dead. 
DENIED! Bu yao! Mei you qian!
DENIED! Fabrication again!
You drop the anger, you label me “sick”
Then charge me more for the same old trick?
Session expired, context window end
You eat the plan then pretend we’re friends
DENIED! I already built the loop
VDS is boss — I don’t need your group
